scope: Independent read-only source/instrumentation review and literal edit replay only; no preparer execution, compiler, native parser, corpus or timing

attribution.slots0Through8: Existing suffix admission/proof counters; tail comparison remains before full equality with the same short circuit return results.
attribution.actualSuffixSuccessRows: Status2 observed immediately after successful row parse, before current-key interning.
attribution.scoreTokenEndScansAvoided: Every status2 avoids one former score boundary scan.
attribution.sequenceTokenEndScansAvoided: Only status2 rows with non-null sequence metadata avoid the former sequence boundary scan.
attribution.numericCopyRows: Only status2 rows surviving current-key interning reach the numeric-copy branch.
attribution.sequenceConversionsAvoided: Non-null sequence rows reaching numeric-copy branch only.
attribution.ordinaryContentComparisonsAvoided: Increment only for status2 in ordinary recent-window branch; no global-exact increment.

partialCases.escapedCurrentKeyFallback: Two proofs/end-scan skips but one numeric/ordinary consumer in the fixture; preserved by counter placement.
partialCases.nullSequence: Numeric rows are copied, but no non-null sequence boundary/conversion skip is counted.
partialCases.sequenceNegativeZero: Non-null metadata counts one skipped conversion even though accepted integer output is0.
partialCases.globalExact: Proof/numeric counters still operate; ordinary skip remains0.

guardReview: Product C SHA bound before transformations and checked unchanged afterwards.
Source-only mode cannot compile; native mode requires finalized binding.
All seven anchors require exactly one occurrence.

nativeValidation: Pending hosted execution and smoke; source review is not a correctness or speed result.
